annotations.title: Search boats for sale on Boatopoly

description: Searches the boats for sale on Boatopoly (active adverts) with the filters of the website's search: words (manufacturer, model, words of the title or description, or an advert number), the boat type, the manufacturer, the model, new or used, the country, the price in euros, the length in metres and the year built. Returns the matching boats (price, length, year, place, the link to each advert) and the number of matches, at most 20 per call; get_boat gives the details of one.

boat_type.description: The boat type: power = Motor boat, sail = Sailboat, small = Small boat, vessel = Vessel, other-boats = Other boats, trailer = Trailer, motor = Motor, equipment = Equipment, moorings = Moorings, other-equipment = Other equipment.

country.description: The country of the boat as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, several separated by commas, e.g. "DE" or "HR,IT,GR".

language.description: The language of the conversation with the seller: German (de), English (en), Spanish (es), Czech (cs), French (fr), Italian (it), Dutch (nl), Polish (pl), Croatian (hr), Slovenian (sl), Latvian (lv), Swedish (sv) or Portuguese (pt) (default English). The answers and the links to Boatopoly come in this language.

model.description: The model, or a part of it, e.g. "Cruiser 34".

offset.description: Skip this many matches: the next page of the same search.

query.description: Words to look for, e.g. "Bavaria Cruiser 34" or "catamaran"; or an advert number.

sort.description: The order: relevance (with words, the default then), newest (otherwise the default), price, length or year.

year_max.description: Built in this year or earlier.

year_min.description: Built in this year or later.
